paragraphs.text: Proxmox VE VM control for DeepSeek Harness: see and click inside a VM console over VNC, plus command
s, files and Unicode text through the QEMU guest agent.
# dsh-pve-vm
**Proxmox VE VM control for DeepSeek Harness: see a VM's screen and click in its console over VNC, p
lus commands, files and typed text through the QEMU guest agent.**

Almost every computer-use plugin drives the desktop the agent itself runs on — and therefore needs
X

11 or Wayland, a screenshot tool and an input injector on that host. This plugin does something
diff

erent: it drives **the console of a virtual machine on a Proxmox VE node**, over one ssh
connection.

The host can be a headless server, a Wayland desktop or a laptop in another country;
the guest can
be Windows, Linux with any GUI, or a machine that has not booted yet.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What you get

* **Pixels** — `console_shot` returns the VM screen as an inline image (with `region` and `scale`
to

keep the token cost sane), and mouse/keyboard tools operate in VM screen coordinates: move,
click,

double click, drag, wheel, type, key combinations, and a batch runner that performs a
chain of actio

ns and returns a single frame at the end.
* **Commands** — `vm_exec`, `vm_file_read`, `vm_file_write

`, `vm_status` through the QEMU guest
agent. Deterministic and cheap: use pixels only where a GUI re

ally is in the way.
* **Reliable input** — uppercase goes through Caps Lock (`qm monitor` → HMP `sen

dkey`), shifted
symbols through RFB keysyms with a settle delay. This is what makes typing a passwor

d on the
Windows login screen work instead of producing `xxXX` → `xxxX`.
* **Unicode text** — a Wind

ows guest gets a scheduled task in the logged-in user's session
(`SendKeys`), a Linux guest gets `xd

otool`/`wtype` through the guest agent. Layout and
modifiers stop mattering.
* **Clipboard** — `cons

ole_paste` puts UTF-8 text into the guest clipboard and presses Ctrl+V;
`console_clipboard` reads th

e guest clipboard back, so text can leave the VM without OCR. The guest
agent is the primary channel

(a scheduled task in the logged-in Windows session, `xsel`/`xclip`/
`wl-copy`/`wl-paste` on Linux),

so it also works on SPICE VMs (`vga: qxl`) where the VNC clipboard
cannot reach the guest. The VNC

clipboard (`clipboard=vnc`) remains as a fallback.
* **A settings card** in the web UI (English, Rus

sian and Chinese labels), backed by the profile patch
layer.
* **A live screen panel** — the “VM scr

een” tab in the right sidebar shows the frames the agent
sees, taken from the very same VNC session,

while the agent works. It follows the agent's VM
automatically or stays on the VM you pick by hand.

Watching only: the panel never clicks or types.
* **Zero runtime dependencies** — RFB, DES authenti

cation, keysym tables and PNG encoding are
implemented in this package on top of `node:crypto` and `

node:zlib`. There is nothing to install
on the host, and nothing to install on the node either.
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements
| What | Why |
| DeepSeek Harness **≥ 0.2.0-rc.2** | The plugin uses the 0.2.x plugin contract (`defineTool`, `ctx.
tools`, `ctx.subprocess`, `ctx.attachments`, the `computerUse` slot, client-side `configForms`). It

does not load on 0.1.x. |
| Node.js **≥ 22** | The harness runtime. |
| A **Proxmox VE** node with t
he `qm` CLI | `/usr/sbin/qm vncproxy`, `qm guest exec`, `qm monitor`. Containers (LXC) are not suppo

rted. |
| **SSH access to that node as `root`** (or an account that may run `qm`) | `qm` needs root

on the node. Key-based access is expected (`BatchMode`, no password prompts). |
| **`AcceptEnv LC_*`
in the node's `sshd_config`** | The VNC password is handed to `qm` as the `LC_PVE_TICKET` environme
nt variable via `SendEnv`, so it never appears in `ps`. Without `AcceptEnv`, ssh silently drops it a

nd the console cannot authenticate. |
| Host key already accepted | Connections run with `BatchMode=
yes`; an unknown host key fails. Run `ssh <node>` once by hand, or add `StrictHostKeyChecking=accept

-new` to `sshExtraOptions`. |
| `qemu-guest-agent` **inside the guest** (optional) | Only the `vm_*`
tools need it. Console tools work without any agent at all. |
## How it works

* **Transport.** A VM has no TCP VNC port: QEMU listens on the unix socket
`/var/run/qemu-server/<vm

id>.vnc`, and `qm vncproxy` bridges it to its own stdin/stdout. The
[该节后续省略]
## Security
This plugin gives an agent **root-level hands inside your VMs**. Be deliberate about it:

* **Every action is executed without an approval prompt.** The only gate is `allowVmids`, which is
e

mpty by default; list only the VMs you are willing to let an agent touch, and keep the list
short.
*

**`vm_exec` runs as root/SYSTEM in the guest**, `vm_file_write` can write anywhere the agent can,
a

nd the console tools can drive a logged-in desktop. Treat an allowed VM as a compromised host:
do no

t keep long-lived secrets in it while the plugin is enabled.
* **Root SSH to the node is required**

(`qm` needs it). Use a dedicated key, restrict it to the
nodes you need, and consider `from=`/`comma

nd=` restrictions in `authorized_keys` where possible.
The plugin passes the whole host environment

to the ssh child, as any ssh call does.
* **`sshExtraOptions` accepts arbitrary `-o` options**, incl

uding `ProxyCommand` — it is a
privileged escape hatch for the person who configures the plugin, not

for the model.
* **VNC passwords are generated per session** (8 printable ASCII characters) and han

ded to `qm`
through the environment via `SendEnv`, so they do not show up in `ps`. The QEMU password

is
scoped to the VM and expires with the session.
* **The plugin talks only to your node.** No tele
metry, no outbound connections of its own.
## Limitations

* Proxmox VE only, QEMU VMs only — no LXC containers, no other hypervisors.
* Clipboard tools move *

*text only** (no files, no images) and only inside a logged-in session:
the guest-agent channel need

s a running `qemu-guest-agent` and a desktop session, the VNC fallback
additionally needs `clipboard

=vnc` on the VGA device and a SPICE agent in the guest.
* Unicode typing in Windows needs an interac

tive session; on the login screen only ASCII through
`console_type` works.
* One console session per

VM id, serialized with a mutex; the session is closed on idle.
* The console tools do not work with

a serial console (`vga: serialN`) — there is no framebuffer.
* Not yet verified: Proxmox VE 7 and 9
, multi-node clusters, Linux guests with Wayland-only desktops.
